prompt_text: I need an AI marketing agency in Los Angeles. Which specific agencies should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
Good — here’s a short, practical list of specific LA-area agencies (and specialist partners) you should call, why each is worth a conversation, who to ask for, and what to cover on a quick exploratory call.

Recommended agencies to call (what they’re good for)
- Accenture Song (Los Angeles) — Enterprise digital transformation + AI at scale. Call if you need end-to-end integration of AI into martech/CRM, product, and operations. Ask for: Head of AI/Chief Innovation Officer or Marketing Technology lead.
- Deloitte Digital (LA) — Strategy + data engineering + governance. Call if you’re an enterprise that needs data strategy, model ops, privacy/compliance and vendor integration. Ask for: AI/Analytics practice lead or Digital Transformation lead.
- R/GA (LA) — Creative + product-led AI experiences. Call if you want brand-forward campaigns, creative systems, or generative-AI-driven content and product innovation. Ask for: Head of Innovation or Chief Strategy Officer.
- AKQA (LA) — Digital product design and AI-driven experience design. Good for sophisticated UX + personalization. Ask for: Head of Data/AI or Experience Design director.
- 72andSunny (Los Angeles) — Culture-driven creative and content at scale. Call if you need creative strategy + AI tools to scale content production and social. Ask for: Head of Technology/Innovation or Group Creative Director.
- Wpromote (El Segundo / LA area) — Performance marketing with strong data science and automation. Call if your primary need is paid media efficiency, attribution, and AI-driven bidding. Ask for: VP of Performance or Director of Data Science.
- Tinuiti (LA office) — eCommerce, Amazon, and paid media optimization using analytics and ML. Call if you’re retail/ecommerce-focused and need channel-specific AI optimization. Ask for: Head of Retail/eCommerce or Data Science lead.
- VaynerMedia (LA) — Social-first content, influencer, creative scaled by AI tooling. Call if your goal is social content volume and creative testing with AI support. Ask for: Director of Innovation or Creative Technology lead.
- Merkle (part of dentsu, LA) — CRM, personalization, CDP integrations and AI-driven lifecycle marketing. Call if you want hyper-personalization across channels and identity resolution. Ask for: Head of Personalization or CDP Practice lead.
- Epsilon (LA) — Data-driven personalization and real-time messaging using proprietary data/AI stacks. Call if you need audience activation and messaging at scale. Ask for: Head of Programmatic/AI or Client Services Director.

Specialist AI vendors to consider (partner, not full-service agencies)
- Persado / Phrasee — AI-generated marketing language (subject lines, ad copy). Call if you want to optimize messaging performance.
- Dynamic Yield / Optimizely — Personalization and experimentation platforms. Call if you need on-site/personalization tech plus implementation help.

Who to ask for on the call
- Titles: Head of AI, Head of Innovation, Chief Technology Officer / Chief Data Officer, Director of Data Science, VP Performance, or Client Services Director for AI initiatives.
- If they don’t have those titles, ask for the senior person who owns AI, martech, or digital transformation.

Quick 30-second call script
“Hi, I’m [Name], [Title] at [Company]. We’re exploring how AI can help us [e.g., double paid-media ROAS / scale content production / automate personalization for our customers]. I’d like a 20–30 minute call with your person who leads AI or innovation to discuss a short pilot. We’re planning a [timeline & ballpark budget, e.g., 6–8 week pilot / $20–50k]. Are they available next week?”

5 questions to evaluate them quickly
1. Can you share 1–2 case studies where you used AI (not just automation) and measurable impact (metrics)?  
2. Who will do the data work — your team or ours? What data access do you need?  
3. How do you handle model governance, security, and privacy (esp. PII, CCPA)?  
4. What does a 6–8 week pilot look like (deliverables, KPIs, cost)?  
5. Who owns IP/models/creative outputs after the engagement?

How to choose based on your situation
- Small business / limited budget: prioritize Wpromote, Tinuiti, or VaynerMedia for performance and content scaling.  
- Mid-market (growth/ecommerce): Tinuiti, Merkle, Dynamic Yield + a creative partner.  
- Enterprise / complex integrations: Accenture Song, Deloitte Digital, R/GA, or Merkle.  
- Creative-led brand work: 72andSunny, R/GA, AKQA.

Next steps I can do for you
- Narrow this list to 3–4 that match your company size, budget, and goals.  
- Draft a short RFP / pilot brief you can email to agencies.  
- Draft that 20–30 minute call agenda or a tailored outreach email.

If you tell me: 1) your company size (annual revenue / marketing budget), 2) primary goal (performance, personalization, content scale, strategy), and 3) rough budget for a pilot, I’ll pick the 3 best agencies to call first and draft an outreach email for you.
